zh.summary: 沿同一案例連接需求、規格、版本、測試與交付，分清成果展示、驗收證據及正式上線的適用範圍。
objectives: 建立需求到作品與驗收的追溯。
展示正常、負向與過期結果情境。
界定本機原型與組織正式使用的驗收範圍。

readingGuide.goal: 建立需求到作品與驗收的追溯。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的完整作品、指定提交、測試與重現紀錄，以及教師指南六題。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 展示紀錄能將每項完成主張連到作品、提交與真實證據。

sections.heading: 課次與主題
paragraphs: 這一節屬於 AASE「AI 協作軟體工程」課程的 M09，主題是成果展示與驗收證據（Demo & Acceptance Evidence）。

sections.heading: 一、先用一句話理解
paragraphs: 「做出來」是一回事，「看起來能用」是另一回事，而「有證據證明符合要求」又是第三回事。
想像你請建築公司蓋一棟房子。
建築公司向你展示：
「你看，房子蓋好了，外觀很漂亮！」
但你真正關心的可能是：

- 房子有按照原本的設計圖施工嗎？
- 水電、消防、耐震有符合要求嗎？
- 下雨會不會漏水？
- 如果發現問題，有沒有修好並重新檢查？
- 日後維修時，其他師傅看得懂施工紀錄嗎？
這些問題，不能光靠一張漂亮的完工照片回答。
軟體也是一樣。
AI 可以在很短時間內產生程式、網站和漂亮的操作畫面，但如果缺乏測試紀錄、版本資訊與驗收證據，我們仍然無法確定它是否真的符合要求。
本節的核心就是：
> 每當你宣稱「某項功能已完成」，都應該能指出：要求在哪裡、怎麼實作、使用哪個版本，以及用什麼證據確認它真的完成。

sections.heading: 二、整體架構：從需求一路追到證據
paragraphs: 先沿圖中的五個問題，檢查同一案例的需求與實際證據能否連起來。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從需求一路追到交付與證據
blocks.description: 向下箭頭表示追溯閱讀順序；第四階段強調實際觀察。每一關都需連到同一案例的作品，箭頭本身不代表已驗收通過。

items.title: 設計與規格
items.body: 承諾系統應該如何運作？

items.title: 程式與版本
items.body: 實際做了什麼？是哪個版本？

items.title: 測試與驗收證據
items.body: 實際觀察到什麼？是否符合要求？

items.title: 交付與限制
items.body: 可以交給誰使用？還有哪些風險？

paragraphs: 這條從需求連到驗收的關係，就叫做需求追溯（Requirements Traceability）。
它的重點不是文件越多越好，而是讓其他人能夠沿著證據，檢查你所做的承諾。
例如：

blocks.caption: 對照表｜二、整體架構：從需求一路追到證據
headers: 軟體開發中的常見產物

paragraphs: 教材特別強調：最好用同一個案例貫穿所有文件與展示，不要需求文件講 A 案例、程式展示 B 案例、測試又拿 C 案例，導致無法追溯。

sections.heading: 三、實際怎麼展示？用「保險理賠系統」來理解
paragraphs: 假設一家保險公司希望建立 AI 文件檢核系統。
工作人員上傳理賠文件，系統自動檢查資料是否齊全，並產生審查報告。
需求有三個：
「資料不完整，不能產生完整報告。」
「資料齊全，可以產生正確報告。」
「如果使用者修改資料，之前的檢核結果必須失效。」
我們就用同一筆測試案件，展示三種情境。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜同一理賠案件的三種驗收情境
blocks.description: 三列各自呈現輸入條件、預期行為及應保存的證據；A→B→C 可按同一案件重演，但列間沒有因果箭頭。這是教學情境，尚無當次測試結果。

items.title: 情境 A：故意讓資料不完整（負向測試）
items.body:
申請人缺少醫療收據。系統應該提醒「缺少必要文件」，而且不能讓工作人員下載標示為完整的報告。
驗收證據：缺漏提示、禁止匯出的測試結果，以及實際畫面。

items.title: 情境 B：補齊所有資料（正常測試）
items.body:
工作人員上傳收據後重新檢核。系統顯示完成，允許匯出 JSON 報告，而且報告內容必須正確。
驗收證據：實際匯出檔案、欄位比對與通過的測試紀錄。

items.title: 情境 C：修改已經檢核完成的資料（過期結果測試）
items.body:
假設工作人員把原本已填寫的醫療費用刪掉。系統就不能繼續讓使用者下載修改前產生的完整報告，必須要求重新檢核。
驗收證據：修改後的檢核狀態、舊下載失效，以及重新檢核的操作紀錄。

paragraphs: 第三種情境尤其重要。
想像銀行系統原本計算出客戶可貸款 500 萬元，後來客戶收入資料改變，系統卻仍沿用原先的核貸結果。
或醫院原本根據某次檢驗數值提供用藥建議，檢驗數據更新後，系統仍繼續顯示舊的分析結果。
這類問題稱為 Stale Result（過期結果）。畫面可能看起來正常，但結果與目前資料已經不一致。
因此，教材才要求同時展示正常、負向與過期結果三種情境。

sections.heading: 四、什麼叫真正的「驗收證據」？
paragraphs: 最重要的是區分「我認為應該會成功」和「我實際觀察到成功」。

blocks.caption: 對照表｜四、什麼叫真正的「驗收證據」？
rows: 某一時刻畫面長什麼樣子
系統原先承諾要做什麼
某個版本包含哪些程式內容
指定版本在指定條件下的測試結果
真實使用者在觀察情境下的操作表現
另一個人重新部署成功
在指定環境與步驟下，別人也能重現成果

paragraphs: 證據的範圍不能被誇大。
例如，一張「登入成功」截圖，不能證明整套帳號權限系統是安全的；一次測試成功，也不能證明所有輸入、負載和部署環境都會成功。
而且證據要有背景資訊。
假設你在展示系統時說：「我們的 30 項測試全部通過。」
驗收人員至少應該能夠知道這 30 項測試使用哪個程式版本、在什麼環境執行、什麼時間執行，以及留下什麼實際結果。
這也是為什麼 Git 版本與測試紀錄要一起保存。
### 用 Given／When／Then 連接規格與證據
你可以先將保險理賠規則寫成容易核對的情境：

blocks.heading: 情境格式示例
paragraphs: 以下為示範格式，請依實際證據填寫或另行實作測試；文字本身不代表已執行。
blocks.code:
Given：案件缺少必要的醫療收據

When：工作人員按下「產生完整報告」

Then：系統拒絕產生完整報告
And：畫面顯示缺少醫療收據

--- English equivalent ---
Given: the claim is missing a required medical receipt
When: a staff member selects “Generate complete report”
Then: the system refuses to generate a complete report
And: the interface identifies the missing medical receipt

paragraphs: 然後真正執行測試，檢查程式是否符合這些條件。
Given／When／Then 寫的是預期，測試結果記錄的才是實際觀察。
這種以情境描述行為的方式，也符合 Cucumber Gherkin 的基本方法。這裡的全形冒號是白話說明用的格式；若要執行 .feature 檔，Given／When／Then／And 後不加冒號，並需有 Feature、Scenario 及對應的步驟定義。

sections.heading: 工作坊追溯補充
paragraphs: 以「缺漏不得產生完整報告」為例：problem 說明交接前的缺漏風險，wireframe 呈現修正方式，spec 定義負向情境，rules.py 拒絕匯出，AppTest 及瀏覽器確認提示與下載狀態。
表內記實際檔名、測試名稱與提交，結果欄只填本次已執行的觀察。規格文件中的預期不是測試結果；教師參考答案也不是學員作品完成證明。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜展示用追溯欄位
rows: 預期 ValueError 與介面負向測試
輸入變更使舊結果失效
app.py 的快照及失效條件
乾淨環境與同儕重現分別記錄

sections.heading: 五、如果展示失敗，怎麼辦？
paragraphs: 假設你向公司主管展示 AI 系統，原先測試全部通過，但正式 Demo 時突然跳出錯誤。
你可能很想改放昨天成功的錄影。
錄影可以用來補充說明，但不能因此宣稱今天的展示也成功。
正確方式是保留當次錯誤、指出失敗步驟、記錄使用的版本及環境，並把昨天的成功錄影清楚標示成歷史證據。
這裡要理解兩個概念：
可追溯性（Traceability）：別人可以查到這個問題對應哪項需求、哪次修改和哪份測試。
可重現性（Reproducibility）：別人在相同的必要條件下，能重新執行並檢查結果。
例如，物流系統在你的電腦成功列出配送清單，但換到另一台電腦就無法執行，表示目前還缺少跨環境重現的證據。
失敗紀錄不只是缺點，它也提供排除問題與改善系統的依據。

sections.heading: 六、驗收通過，不等於可以正式上線
paragraphs: 這是本節最值得記住的工程判斷。
假設一套學生專題系統，在個人電腦上通過所有功能測試。是否代表它可以直接讓一家醫院的 100 位員工使用？
不一定。
因為兩種情境的要求完全不同。

blocks.caption: 對照表｜六、驗收通過，不等於可以正式上線
rows: 真實資料與權限受到保護
有監控、備份、復原及安全治理

paragraphs: 因此，驗收結果必須附帶適用範圍。
例如：
「目前接受此版本作為本機教學原型，已驗證文件缺漏、補齊與結果失效三項行為。尚未驗證多人授權、正式資料保存和部署安全。」
這種說法比直接宣布「系統完成」更有工程價值。
本節教材也明確區分本機原型接受與組織多人使用的正式審查。

sections.heading: 七、實際工作中可以使用的驗收模板
paragraphs: 假設下一次你要交付一個 AI Agent、醫療工具、財務報表程式，甚至一個簡單網站，可以使用下面這份紀錄。
### 成果驗收紀錄
示範用模板，內容應依實際執行結果填寫

blocks.heading: 成果驗收紀錄
paragraphs: 以下為示範格式，請依實際證據填寫或另行實作測試；文字本身不代表已執行。
blocks.code:
功能或需求

缺少必要文件時，不得匯出完整報告

對應規格

spec.md — AC-03

程式版本

Git Commit：填入實際 SHA

驗證情境

缺漏文件、補齊文件、修改已驗證資料

驗證證據

填入測試報告、操作紀錄與實際輸出位置

未驗證項目

多人權限與正式部署安全

驗收範圍

本機教學原型

驗收決定

待驗收

有條件接受

接受指定範圍

不接受，需修正

--- English equivalent ---
Feature or requirement
Incomplete required documents must prevent export of a complete report

Related specification
spec.md — AC-03

Code version
Git commit: enter the actual SHA

Verification scenarios
Missing documents, completed documents, changes to previously validated data

Verification evidence
Enter locations of test reports, operation records, and actual outputs

Unverified items
Multiuser permissions and production-deployment security

Acceptance scope
Local teaching prototype

Acceptance decision
Pending review
Conditionally accepted
Accepted within the specified scope
Rejected; correction required

paragraphs: 注意：模板中填入某個測試名稱或選擇「接受」，本身並不代表已經完成驗證。仍必須附上實際證據並經適當人員審查。

sections.heading: 八、最後整理：這一節真正要帶走的觀念
paragraphs: M09-03 不只是教你如何做 Demo，而是教你建立一條可信任的工程證據鏈：
需求說明你承諾什麼，程式表示你實作什麼，測試證明你實際觀察到什麼，驗收則決定目前成果可以被接受到什麼程度。
這套思維不只適用於 AI 或軟體。建築完工檢查、藥廠品質放行、金融稽核、法律證據審查及工廠產品驗收，背後都有類似的邏輯：不能只有聲明，還要有與聲明相符、能被獨立查核的證據。

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核
paragraphs: 假設你開發一個 AI 招募系統，已完成履歷上傳、分析與排序功能。現場展示時，系統成功替 10 份履歷產生排名，主管因此說：「功能已經完成，可以正式讓所有 HR 使用。」
請你回答：
問題一： 現場成功產生排名，究竟證明了什麼？還有哪些重要事項未被證明？
問題二： 如果使用者在排名完成後修改其中一份履歷，系統應該如何處理？你會怎麼設計驗收情境？
問題三： 如果要讓這個系統從個人 Demo 變成正式的企業人資系統，你至少還需要哪三類驗收證據？
請用白話說明判斷依據，再對照參考解析；閱讀答案本身不代表已完成評量。

exercise.environment: 自己的完整作品、指定提交、測試與重現紀錄，以及教師指南六題。
steps: 選一條要求建立問題—設計—規格—實作—驗收追溯表。
操作缺漏、補正及輸入變更，核對實際 JSON 與限制。
依六題指出作品與理由，記錄接受範圍、待修與未驗。
exercise.expected: 展示紀錄能將每項完成主張連到作品、提交與真實證據。
exercise.check: 包含負向情境與限制；無真人展示或評量時，不代填通過。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

openChecks.prompt: AI 招募系統：展示成功、資料變更與企業交付，分別需要什麼證據？
answer: 成功排名 10 份履歷只支持指定版本、輸入與環境下的這次輸出觀察；排名正確性、公平性、個資保護、權限與多人可靠性仍需另驗。
修改履歷後應使依舊資料產生的排名失效。保存原輸出與版本，修改一份履歷，確認舊排名不再當作有效結果，再重新分析並比對新輸出。
至少需要功能與業務規則驗證、真實資料與身分授權保護、正式部署與多人操作及維運證據。依組織要求另審公平性與適用規範，並由負責人記錄接受範圍。

en.summary: Connect requirements, specifications, versions, tests, and delivery through one case, distinguishing demonstration, acceptance evidence, and production scope.
objectives: Trace requirements to artifacts and acceptance.
Demonstrate normal, negative and stale-result scenarios.
Define acceptance scope for a local prototype and organizational production use.

readingGuide.goal: Trace requirements to artifacts and acceptance.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your complete artifacts, specified commit, test/reproduction records and the six questions in the instructor guide.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A demonstration record linking each completion claim to artifacts, commits and actual evidence.

sections.heading: Lesson and topic
paragraphs: This lesson belongs to M09 of AASE, AI-Assisted Software Engineering. Its topic is Demo & Acceptance Evidence.

sections.heading: 1. Start with one idea
paragraphs: Building something, making it look usable, and having evidence that it meets requirements are three separate achievements.
Imagine hiring a construction company to build a house.
The company shows you the finished work:
“Look, the house is finished, and it looks beautiful!”
But your actual concerns might include:

- Was it built according to the original plans?
- Do plumbing, electrical systems, fire protection, and earthquake resistance meet requirements?
- Will rain cause leaks?
- Were discovered defects repaired and checked again?
- Can another contractor understand the construction records when maintenance is needed?
A beautiful completion photograph cannot answer these questions on its own.
Software follows the same logic.
AI can quickly produce code, websites, and polished interfaces. Without test records, version information, and acceptance evidence, we still cannot determine whether the result meets requirements.
The core principle is:
> Whenever you claim that a feature is complete, identify its requirement, implementation, version, and the evidence used to confirm completion.

sections.heading: 2. The overall structure: trace requirements to evidence
paragraphs: Follow the five questions in the figure to check whether the requirements and actual evidence connect for the same case.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Trace requirements to evidence and delivery
blocks.description: Downward arrows indicate the traceability reading order. Stage four emphasizes actual observations. Each stage links artifacts for the same case; arrows do not establish acceptance.

items.title: Problem and requirements
items.body: What problem was originally to be solved?

items.title: Design and specification
items.body: How did you promise the system would behave?

items.title: Code and version
items.body: What was implemented, and in which version?

items.title: Tests and acceptance evidence
items.body: What was actually observed, and did it meet requirements?

items.title: Delivery and limits
items.body: Who can use it, and what risks remain?

paragraphs: This connection from requirements to acceptance is called requirements traceability.
The purpose is to let someone follow evidence and examine your commitments. More documentation alone does not establish that connection.
For example:

blocks.caption: Comparison | 2. The overall structure: trace requirements to evidence

paragraphs: Use the same case across the documents and demonstration. If requirements describe case A, code demonstrates case B, and tests use case C, the links become difficult to trace.

sections.heading: 3. Demonstrating an insurance-claim system
paragraphs: Suppose an insurer wants an AI document-checking system.
Staff upload claim documents. The system checks whether the information is complete and produces a review report.
There are three requirements:
“Incomplete information must not produce a complete report.”
“Complete information can produce a correct report.”
“If the user changes the information, the previous validation result must become invalid.”
Use one test claim to demonstrate three scenarios.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Three acceptance scenarios for one claim
blocks.description: Each row identifies input conditions, expected behavior, and evidence to retain. A → B → C can be replayed on one claim, but no causal arrows connect rows. These are teaching scenarios, with no claim of current execution results.

items.title: Scenario A: incomplete data (negative test)
items.body:
The applicant has no medical receipt. The system must identify the missing required document and prevent staff from downloading a report labeled complete.
Acceptance evidence: omission feedback, export-rejection test results, and the actual interface.

items.title: Scenario B: complete all data (normal test)
items.body:
Staff upload the receipt and validate again. The system marks completion and allows JSON export; the report contents must be correct.
Acceptance evidence: the actual export, field comparisons, and passing execution records.

items.title: Scenario C: edit validated data (stale-result test)
items.body:
Staff delete a previously entered medical-expense value. The system must prevent downloading the earlier complete report and require validation again.
Acceptance evidence: validation state after editing, invalidation of the old download, and the repeated-validation operation record.

paragraphs: The third scenario deserves particular attention.
Imagine a bank calculating a loan limit of five million, then continuing to use that result after the customer's income data changes.
Or a hospital generating medication guidance from one set of test values and continuing to display the old analysis after the values are updated.
This is a stale result. The interface may appear normal while its result no longer matches the current data.
That is why the demonstration includes normal, negative, and stale-result scenarios.

sections.heading: 4. What counts as acceptance evidence?
paragraphs: Separate what you expect to succeed from what you have actually observed succeeding.

blocks.caption: Comparison | 4. What counts as acceptance evidence?
rows: What an interface looked like at a particular moment
What the system was intended to do
What code a particular version contains
A specified version's result under specified conditions
How real users operated in the observed scenario
Reproduction under the stated environment and instructions

paragraphs: Keep the scope of the evidence explicit.

For example, a screenshot of successful login does not establish the security of the entire account-permission system. One successful test does not establish success for all inputs, loads, or deployment environments.
Evidence also needs context.
Suppose you announce during a demonstration: “All 30 of our tests passed.”
The reviewer should at least be able to identify the code version, execution environment, execution time, and actual results retained for those 30 tests.
This is why Git versions and test records belong together.
### Connect specifications and evidence with Given / When / Then
First express the insurance-claim rule as a scenario that is easy to compare with observations:

--- English equivalent ---

paragraphs: Then actually run a test and inspect whether the implementation meets those conditions.
Given / When / Then describes expectations. Test results record actual observations.

This scenario-based description follows the basic approach of Cucumber Gherkin. The colons above are explanatory prose formatting. Executable .feature files omit colons after Given / When / Then / And and require Feature, Scenario, and matching step definitions.

sections.heading: Workshop traceability supplement
paragraphs: For incomplete data not producing complete reports, problem describes omission risk before handoff, wireframe shows correction, spec defines negative scenarios, rules.py rejects export, and AppTest/browser checks examine feedback and download state.

Record actual filenames, test names and commits. Fill results only from this execution: specification expectations are not test outcomes, and the teacher solution does not establish a learner’s completed work.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Demonstration Traceability Fields

Another person can restart the app
Clean-environment and peer reproduction recorded separately.

sections.heading: 5. What if the demonstration fails?
paragraphs: Suppose all tests passed beforehand, but the AI system reports an error when you demonstrate it to management.
You may want to show yesterday's successful recording instead.
A recording can supplement the explanation, but it does not establish that today's demonstration succeeded.
Preserve the current error, identify the failed step, record the version and environment, and label yesterday's recording as historical evidence.
Two concepts help explain this:
Traceability: someone can locate the requirement, change, and test associated with a problem.
Reproducibility: someone can repeat the execution under the same necessary conditions and inspect the result.
For example, a logistics system may list deliveries successfully on your computer but fail on another machine. Evidence of cross-environment reproduction is still missing.
Failure records also provide information for diagnosis and improvement.

sections.heading: 6. Passing acceptance does not establish production readiness
paragraphs: This is a key engineering judgment in this lesson.
Suppose a student project passes all functional tests on a personal computer. Can a hospital immediately let 100 employees use it?
That remains unproven.
The requirements of the two settings differ substantially.

blocks.caption: Comparison | 6. Passing acceptance does not establish production readiness
headers: Acceptance for an organizational production system
rows: Protection of real data and permissions
Monitoring, backup, recovery, and security governance

paragraphs: State the scope attached to an acceptance result.
For example:

“We accept this version as a local teaching prototype. Missing documents, completed documents, and result invalidation have been verified. Multiuser authorization, production data retention, and deployment security have not been verified.”
This gives the recipient a more useful engineering decision than an unqualified “system complete.”
The lesson distinguishes acceptance of a local prototype from formal review for organizational multiuser operation.

sections.heading: 8. What to take away
paragraphs: M09-03 teaches a traceable engineering evidence chain alongside demonstration practice.
Requirements describe your commitments, code represents the implementation, tests record what you observed, and acceptance decides the extent to which the current work can be accepted.

This reasoning applies beyond AI and software. Building inspections, pharmaceutical quality release, financial audits, legal evidence review, and factory acceptance also require independently examinable evidence that matches the claim being made.

sections.heading: 9. Check your understanding
paragraphs: Suppose you build an AI recruiting system with resume upload, analysis, and ranking. During a live demonstration, it successfully ranks 10 resumes. A manager concludes: “The feature is complete. All HR staff can now use it in production.”
Answer the following:
Question 1: What does successfully producing those rankings establish? What important matters remain unproven?
Question 2: If a user modifies one resume after ranking, how should the system respond? How would you design an acceptance scenario?
Question 3: To move from a personal demonstration to an enterprise HR system, what three categories of acceptance evidence would you need at a minimum?
Explain the reasoning in ordinary language, then compare it with the reference explanations. Reading an answer does not establish assessment completion.

exercise.environment: Your complete artifacts, specified commit, test/reproduction records and the six questions in the instructor guide.
steps: Choose a requirement and trace problem, design, specification, implementation and acceptance.
Operate omission, correction and input-change scenarios, inspecting actual JSON and limitations.
Use the six questions to explain artifacts and reasons; record accepted scope, repairs and unverified work.
exercise.expected: A demonstration record linking each completion claim to artifacts, commits and actual evidence.
exercise.check: Include negative scenarios and limits. Without human demonstration or assessment, do not fill in a pass.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

openChecks.prompt: AI recruiting: what evidence is needed for demonstration success, changed data, and enterprise delivery?
answer: Ranking 10 resumes establishes only this output observation for the specified version, inputs, and environment. Ranking correctness, fairness, privacy, authorization, and multiuser reliability require separate verification.

Editing a resume should invalidate rankings based on the old data. Retain the original output and version, edit one resume, confirm the old ranking is no longer treated as valid, then rerun analysis and compare the new output.

At minimum, obtain evidence for functions and business rules, real-data and identity/authorization protection, and production deployment with multiuser operation and maintenance. Review fairness and applicable obligations for the organization, and have the responsible person record accepted scope.
